yt-dlp._comment_v1.3.0: v1.3.0+ builds yt-dlp.exe from upstream source via build/build-patched-ytdlp.ps1 instead of downloading the prebuilt binary. The runtime hook in build/yt-dlp-patch/ lowers OpenSSL SECLEVEL when the env var YTDLP_RELAX_SECLEVEL=1 is set; otherwise yt-dlp behaves identically to upstream. See build/yt-dlp-patch/README.md for the audit trail.
yt-dlp._comment_v1.4.0: Built with PyInstaller --onedir, not --onefile, and shipped as bin/yt-dlp-pkg.zip. An onefile binary re-extracts its whole ~40MB bundle to a fresh %TEMP%/_MEIxxxxxx on EVERY run, so AV rescans it every time: two field machines measured 18-24s of that before yt-dlp ran a single line of its own code. See src/YtDlpTool.Process/YtDlpLayout.cs. The version bump from 2026.03.17 is REQUIRED, not incidental: UpdateChecker compares this string against what `yt-dlp --version` reports on the user's machine, so an unchanged version means existing installs would never be offered the new layout.
